text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
This card/Digimon is also treated as if its name is [Shoutmon] and [Starmons].
＜Material Save 1＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may place 1 card in this Digimon's DigiXros requirements from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.)
[On Play] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 2000 DP or less.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text:
DigiXros -1: [Shoutmon] × [Starmons]
When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.

qa.answer: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Shoutmon] and [Starmons] names.
qa.question:
What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?
(*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as if its name is [Shoutmon] and [Starmons]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Shoutmon] and [Starmons].")
